  enum Payload
    Text(String)
    Number(Int)
    Empty
  struct Item
    field payload: Payload
    field tail: String
  fun makeItems(): Array<Item>
    val payload
      Binary Add
        StringLiteral "en"
        StringLiteral "um"
    val firstTail
      Binary Add
        StringLiteral "ta"
        StringLiteral "il"
    val secondTail
      Binary Add
        StringLiteral "em"
        StringLiteral "pty"
    return
      ArrayLiteral
        Call Item
          MethodCall Text
            Var Payload
            Var payload
          Var firstTail
        Call Item
          FieldAccess Empty
            Var Payload
          Var secondTail
  fun main()
    val items
      Call makeItems
    Call gcCollect
    when
      FieldAccess payload
        Index
          Var items
          IntLiteral 0
      arm Text(value)
        Call println
          Var value
      arm Number(value)
        Call println
          Var value
      arm Empty
        Call println
          StringLiteral "missing"
    Call println
      FieldAccess tail
        Index
          Var items
          IntLiteral 0
    Call println
      FieldAccess tail
        Index
          Var items
          IntLiteral 1
